notes: StandBy reads the comms (with ReadBack). ReadBack, BSI's comms-to-text app, hears the intercom channels; Show › Link ReadBack… links the caller to it (pick it from the network, type the 4-digit code from ReadBack's Settings › Sharing). Speech never presses GO: StandBy only marks, ticks and writes things down. Who the standby GO needs: the Standby card shows each department with something to do on that GO (from the department columns, with or without ReadBack). Linked, a department ticks when it's heard standing by ("lights standing by", from any channel); the ticks clear on GO. Cues heard on…
